title: Canada: Monty's pool, feet on the ground
kaylee: In the bike film, Monty, Maple and her bike stand on the bank and in the pool instead of sinking into the dirt.

pictures.title: "Will you be our goalie?"
pictures.caption: The trail's dirt no longer lies over the pool's edge: Monty stands in the water, Maple and the bike on the bank

pictures.title: "I am very good at standing."
pictures.caption: The same in the close two-shot
